name: stafftime
description: Domi Time & Scheduling — staff clock-in, scheduling and timesheets

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @stafftime/api && npm run build --workspace @stafftime/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace @stafftime/api && npm run lint --workspace @stafftime/web
